<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/v1/budgets/pricing/entries/{provider}/{model}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



Upsert one (provider, model) rate row. The body must carry exactly one of anthropic / openai / google.
This republishes the ENTIRE merged catalog as a new operator-dated version, but only the entry it
writes becomes operator-managed: every other rate keeps its ownership and a later release's baseline
refresh still reaches the ones nobody pinned. Use POST .../revert to hand this rate back.
